import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Target classes: {train_df['Cover_Type'].nunique()}")

# Identify features (exclude Id and target)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Separate features and target
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()
test_ids = test_df["Id"].copy()

# Hold out validation set (20% of training data)
val_size = int(len(X_train) * 0.2)
val_mask = np.random.RandomState(42).choice(len(X_train), size=val_size, replace=False)
X_val = X_train.iloc[val_mask].reset_index(drop=True)
y_val = y_train.iloc[val_mask].reset_index(drop=True)
X_train_subset = X_train.drop(val_mask, axis=0).reset_index(drop=True)
y_train_subset = y_train.drop(val_mask, axis=0).reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Validation set size: {len(X_val)}")
print(f"Training set (subset) size: {len(X_train_subset)}")

# Train LightGBM model with optimized hyperparameters
print("Training LightGBM model...")
lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=-1,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=-1,
)
lgb_model.fit(X_train_subset, y_train_subset)

# Validate on hold-out set
print("Validating on hold-out set...")
y_val_pred = lgb_model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Hold-out validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
print("Making predictions on test set...")
test_predictions = lgb_model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_predictions})

# Save to submission folder
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")

# Print final stats
print(f"\nFinal validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")
print(f"Predictions made: {len(test_predictions)}")
print(f"Unique predictions: {pd.Series(test_predictions).nunique()}")

# Verify submission file was created
if os.path.exists("submission/submission.csv"):
    sub_df = pd.read_csv("submission/submission.csv")
    print(f"Submission file has {len(sub_df)} rows")
    print(f"Submission columns: {sub_df.columns.tolist()}")
